sources.text: Derkmore Wood Nature Reserve Location: Situated in Gweebarra Forest on exposed undulating ground on the southern flank of Cleengort Hill. GPS: Latitude: 54.838 Longitude: -8.291 Area (ha.): 7 Animals and plants of interest: An area of oak scrub with well developed bryophyte and lichen flora. Established: 1988 Ownership: State-owned
